name: semanticshape
description: Completion, hover and lint diagnostics for foomo walker semantic shape files (*.semanticshape.html)

semanticshape.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path of a `semanticshape-lsp` binary to use instead of the one bundled with the extension. Empty: the bundled one, or - in a build without it - `semanticshape-lsp` on the `PATH`, in `$GOBIN`, `$GOPATH/bin` or `~/go/bin`. A bare name is looked up the same way.

semanticshape.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.
